key_points: Qualcomm announced acquisition of robotics software firm PickNik to expand AI‑robotics capabilities.
Snapdragon Summit 2026 unveiled Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and Extreme Gen 6 chips emphasizing on‑device agentic AI, able to run 30B MoE models locally.
Pre‑market trading showed QCOM up ~2.1%; after‑hours reaction to chip launch was mixed with slight declines.
Company declared a dividend this week, providing income support.
Analyst views diverge: bullish on AI edge opportunity, bearish Seeking Alpha argues AI story limited.
